YUAN Zheng 1 ，XU Jing 2 ，QIU Jin-chun2( 1 Zhengzhou Maternity and Child Health Hospital，Zhengzhou 450003，China;2 Nanjing Children ’ s Hospital Affiliated to Nanjing Medical University，Nanjing 210008，China)［Abstract］ Objestive: To discuss the mechanisms and clinical features of interaction between omeprazole and methotrexate( MTX) in order to provide references for rational use of proton pump inhibitors( PPIs) and MTX． Methods: One case of decreased elimination of MTX potentially induced by a drug interaction between methotrexate and omeprazole in a 9-year-old boy was analyzed and evaluated． Published literatures were searched for cases reports of interaction between PPIs and MTX through CNKI，WanFang Database，and Pubmed Database from 1990 to 2015． Results: Only 10 case reports were collected including two in China． Omeprazole may delay MTX elimination;
